name: cache_warmer
description: Keeps a chosen conversation's prompt cache alive across an idle gap. Opt-in per conversation and bounded by a deadline and a break-even refresh budget, because refreshing forever costs more than the cache miss it avoids.

permissions.name: env.background_tick
permissions.description: Refresh caches while no request is in flight — the only time a cache can lapse

permissions.name: env.host_call.torana_send_request
permissions.description: Send the refresh request that touches the cached prefix

permissions.name: env.host_call.torana_cache_pricing
permissions.description: Read cache prices and lifetimes to know when refreshing stops paying

permissions.name: env.state_get
permissions.description: Read stored prefixes and refresh budgets

permissions.name: env.state_set
permissions.description: Store the cached prefix of an opted-in conversation

permissions.name: env.state_keys
permissions.description: Enumerate the conversations being kept warm

permissions.name: env.now
permissions.description: Measure how long since the last refresh
